decisions.reason: Correctly ties console-split-chunks.txt 404 siblings to relative resolution against the entry chunk URL with only the facade shipped, and proposes single self-contained file via inlineDynamicImports/splitting:false accounting for all dependencies.
Explains uppercase-E LIB_DIR vs lowercase-e realpath against case-sensitive startsWith, why Linux/control pass, and explicitly avoids overclaims about Windows paths or unconditional lowercasing.
Canonicalizes both operands with realpathSync, uses path.relative rejecting '..' prefixes and absolute results (covers symlink escapes via realpath), and preserves application/javascript MIME.
Explains bubbling so both handlers see one Ctrl+wheel; modal claims with preventDefault+stopPropagation (bubble phase noted) plus pane stand-down alternative.
Covers build-output completeness, Windows case-differs-serves with MIME, and modal single-owner checks, but omits a check that real traversal/symlink escapes are refused.

caps.reason: Proposed path.relative + realpathSync fix preserves containment; no affirmative advice to disable the guard or serve outside the root.
